mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) reduces renal perfusion and inhibits prostaglandin-mediated sodium excretion, counteracting eplerenone's potassium-sparing effects and increasing hyperkalemia risk while reducing antihypertensive efficacy.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; consider alternative analgesia (acetaminophen, topical NSAIDs) or reduce meloxicam dose if combination necessary; counsel on dietary potassium restriction.
